headlines.title: Looking back on Dolly Parton's groundbreaking career and music legacy
headlines.description: Country music legend Dolly Parton has died at the age of 80. Her family announced the news in a video posted to social media. NBC News' Chloe Melas reports on the icon's life and legacy.

headlines.title: Dolly Parton’s best moments on TODAY
headlines.description: The singer has stopped by TODAY over the years to talk about her projects, including “Steel Magnolias” in 1989.

headlines.title: Watch Dolly Parton, Savannah Guthrie and Hoda Kotb sing ‘Jolene’
headlines.description: As Dolly Parton visits TODAY live, the control room staff don Dolly wigs, Savannah Guthrie pulls out her guitar, and Hoda Kotb joins Savannah and Dolly in an impromptu performance of the country icon’s classic song “Jolene.”

headlines.title: Dolly Parton: ‘I still love to perform’
headlines.description: The legendary singer joins TODAY to talk about her remarkable career, her marriage, and her latest album, “Blue Smoke.”

headlines.title: Canada announces new tariffs on the U.S. as trade tensions rise
headlines.description: The Canadian government retaliated against President Donald Trump’s latest wave of tariffs by raising tariffs on steel products and imposing a swath of new duties on $20 billion in U.S. products exported to Canada. NBC News' Christine Romans reports on the new tariffs unveiled by Canada as the trade war with the U.S. continues.

headlines.title: Forensic psychologist testifies Lindsay Clancy is 'criminally responsible' for children's deaths
headlines.description: Forensic psychologist Kirk Heilbrun retook the witness stand Tuesday, testifying Lindsay Clancy had a "moral awareness" about the "wrongfulness" of killing her children. NBC News legal analyst Misty Marris explains why this line of questioning is important for the prosecution's case.

headlines.title: Trump administration says it might demolish the Kennedy Center if court blocks renovations
headlines.description: The Trump administration is, for the first time, threatening the demolition of the Kennedy Center if the arts institution isn’t allowed to follow its plans for the site, including adding President Donald Trump’s name to the front of the building.

headlines.title: Immigrant dad of USS Lincoln sailor is released from ICE detention
headlines.description: Navy sailor Joshua Aviles posted a family statement on his Facebook page that his father Luis Manuel Aviles “has been released back to our family.”

headlines.title: CIA director flies unannounced to Moscow to hold talks, source says
headlines.description: CIA Director John Ratcliffe flew to Russia to holds talks in Moscow Tuesday, according to a person with knowledge of the matter.

headlines.title: Kornacki Cam: Watch Steve analyze results from South Carolina's GOP Senate runoff
headlines.description: NBC News chief data analyst Steve Kornacki breaks down real-time vote tallies from South Carolina's GOP Senate runoff between Darline Graham and Ralph Norman, while giving viewers a behind-the-scenes look at election night coverage.
